name: painel-sessao
description: Session panel for Claude Code: the steps of the session with the current one marked, the decisions waiting for you, a queue of next prompts with auto-send, your last messages, notes, and the context window and plan limits. In Portuguese (Brazil) and English.

language.title: Language / Idioma
language.description: Language of the panel: pt-BR (Português do Brasil) or en (English).

timeZone.title: Time zone / Fuso horário
timeZone.description: IANA time zone name the panel shows times in, such as America/Sao_Paulo or Europe/Lisbon. Leave it empty to use the time zone of the system.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane when a session starts / Abrir o painel no início da sessão
openOnStart.description: When on, the pane opens by itself once in each new session. When off, open it with /painel (or /panel).

answerLine.title: Line under each answer / Linha sob cada resposta
answerLine.description: When on, each answer ends with one line: the date, when you asked, when the answer ended and how long it took.
